notes.title: Coloring Game 10K Release
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630684/27f91fd25845755b332844a308ae8e6b363aa963.png

The long-awaited release of Coloring Game 10K.


 All pictures in the game has a size of 10,000 px.
 Size: 90 images / 900,000 px. 
 Duration: 25 hours (Pen Mode) / 13 hours (Fill Mode)


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3759780/Coloring_Game_10K/

Don't forget to leave your feedback.
